items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: I don't know these boys only by reputation

ctx.x: Well, not as much as Eddie, because Eddie was fortunate enough to make this European tour, which really had much to do with his success, because he was a huge success at that time. But I have had quite a bit of success with most of the pupils I had at that time. But they didn't go in for concert work. They did most orchestra work. It was Jimmy Bell. And when they had the orchestra at the Regal Theatre, we had a couple of boys in there. I can't think of their names now. To get back to some of the other…
...and the other instruments, like on trumpet...
